current_article.title: Get ready to rock and roll during the Season of Heritage’s Mountains of Power event — Pokémon GO
current_article.text:
Updates
Get ready to rock and roll during the Season of Heritage’s Mountains of Power event
Mountains of Power
Friday, January 7, 2022, at 10:00 a.m. to Thursday, January 13, 2022, at 8:00 p.m. local time
The Season of Heritage Story Continues!
Spark’s intuition leads him to believe that the mysterious door’s second mechanism requires the help of Rock- and Steel-type Pokémon to unlock it.
Journey through terrain reminiscent of the mountains found in regions like Johto and Sinnoh, and work with Spark to unlock the next mechanism!
Catch up on the story so far on the Season of Heritage web page .
Event Bonus
1/2 walking distance to earn hearts with your buddy
Timed Research
The event will feature Timed Research focused on catching Pokémon, hatching Eggs, and earning Buddy Candy.
Complete the tasks to earn encounters with Pokémon like Mawile and Beldum!
Wild Encounters
The following Pokémon will be appearing more frequently in the wild.
Also, for the first time in Pokémon GO, you’ll be able to encounter a Shiny Slugma, if you’re lucky!
Zubat
Machop
Geodude
Slugma
Nosepass
Barboach
If you’re lucky, you might encounter the following.
Onix
Ferroseed
If you’re lucky, you may encounter a Shiny one!
Raids
The following Pokémon will be appearing in raids. For the first time in Pokémon GO, Mega Aerodactyl will be available in Mega Raids!
One-Star Raids
Alolan Geodude
Onix
Beldum
Bronzor
Three-Star Raids
Ursaring
Donphan
Medicham
Absol
Five-Star Raids
Heatran
Mega Raids
Mega Aerodactyl
Field Research Task Encounters
The following Pokémon will be available to encounter when you complete Field Research tasks!
Alolan Geodude
Slugma
If you’re lucky, you might encounter the following.
Mawile
If you’re lucky, you may encounter a Shiny one!

—The Pokémon GO team
